description: Crispy risotto balls infused with black truffle oil and creamy forest mushrooms, served with roasted garlic aioli.
Atlantic salmon cubes marinated in wild honey and soy, grilled to perfection over charcoal.
Sizzling prawns tossed in a rich brown butter sauce with roasted garlic and fresh parsley.
Toasted sourdough topped with heirloom tomatoes, fresh buffalo mozzarella, and a balsamic glaze reduction.
Fragrant Basmati rice and tender lamb slow-cooked in a sealed clay pot with 24 secret Nawabi spices.
Long-grain rice delicately flavored with Kashmiri saffron, toasted nuts, and dried barberries.
Char-grilled paneer cubes layered with aromatic rice, fried onions, and fresh mint leaves.
Traditional Iranian saffron rice with dried barberries, served with slow-roasted saffron chicken.
Miniature brioche buns hosting premium Wagyu patties, caramelized onions, and aged Gruyère cheese.
Hand-cut golden fries tossed in aromatic truffle oil, fresh parsley, and 24-month aged Parmesan.
Double-fried chicken wings glazed in a spicy-sweet gochujang sauce and white sesame seeds.
Stone-ground corn chips topped with melted cheddar, black beans, jalapeños, and house-made guacamole.
A refreshing blend of fresh mint, lime, and organic cane sugar, topped with edible 24k gold flakes.
Crafted with single-origin shade-grown coffee, premium vodka, and a hint of vanilla bean liqueur.
Steeped hibiscus tea infused with fresh raspberries, blueberries, and a splash of sparkling water.
Ceremonial grade Uji matcha whisked with creamy oat milk and a touch of organic honey.
Mascarpone mousse, espresso-soaked ladyfingers, and dark chocolate soil, elegantly presented in a glass sphere.
Warm Belgian chocolate cake with a molten center, served with house-made Madagascan vanilla gelato.
New York style cheesecake topped with fresh Alfonso mango purée and mint-infused mango chunks.
Silky 70% dark chocolate ganache in a cocoa crust, finished with a sprinkle of Maldon sea salt.
